2. Choose your numbers: For a standard marked entry, choose 7 numbers from 1 to 35 or use the autofill option.

3. Choose 1 Powerball number: Choose a Powerball number from 1 to 20 in a single game panel.

There are 9 Powerball prize divisions. The winning combinations and odds of winning each Powerball prize division (based on 1 standard game) are shown below.

7 winning numbers + the Powerball number Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 134,490,400:1

A System entry gives you the option to play more than the standard 7 numbers from the first barrel of 35. You can choose from 8 to 20 numbers giving you more chances to win. A PowerHit System entry not only guarantees the winning Powerball number, but allows you to pick from 8 to 15 numbers from the main barrel.
